name: Investment Plan
description:
Investment Plan includes:
Deal 1 Piercing DMG to your active character, execute 1 plan related to Healing effect.
Discard 1 random card from your Hand, execute 1 plan related to Draw effect.
Remove 1 of your Elemental Dice, execute 1 plan related to Elemental Dice effect.
